constraints.text: Fallibility requires an asymmetry between what the agent assesses and what its outcome depends on; in the ODE, V and the outcome are functions of the same (y,p), so self-assessment cannot be about something the outcome is not also about — every flat result is a face of this. The evaluator must have access to something the dynamics do not determine
constraints.statusCell: MEASURED (structural); how Stage 2 achieves it is the open crux (§9)

constraints.text: For any self-modifiable choice, check commutativity before claiming fallibility is harmless: apply both orders; identical walks mean no horizon can separate them (the near-tie (α_G, γ_G) commutes exactly — final Params log-distance 0.000000 over 192 generations). In a discrete substrate commutativity is not guaranteed, so accumulation becomes possible

The evaluator must see the controller, or the controller is a blind chooser: all 240 controller margins exactly 0.0 at every alarm state — the actuator/monitor/trigger are structurally invisible to V. Adding the controller to the lever set without widening the evidence first gives a blind chooser

The assessment must close exactly the boundary that is exploitable — a falsifiable test, not an aspiration: the Boundary Correspondence Test, B_failure == B_fix, with partial closure and superficial closure as named failure modes. Binding on exp15 and the evidence-widening component
Three collapse classes, each with a distinguishing signal and a different fix family; the fix must match the class (see §5a)
constraints.statusCell: MEASURED (A's accuracy, B's blindness, Lin's pattern); INTERPRETATION (discriminator)

constraints.text: A fix that helps one layer does not fix another; there are at least two boundaries — the horizon boundary B_h(T) and the context boundary B_c; do not assume one assessment fix closes both

Degradation with a sound evaluator is real and replicated (Lin: 10 sequential campaigns, three model families, rise-then-collapse within a campaign) — the mechanism must not let the optimized proxy drift from the true objective: re-anchor periodically or bound optimization without re-validation

State must be threaded into the integration, not logged beside it: assert on the integrated state, never on a log (artifact 1's carry rows recorded but not threaded — gen-2 solver M_self[0]=0.000000 against a recorded 0.286782, and its T3 test passed because it read the log)

The durable record lives outside the compactable channel, and decisions (not results) are the unrecoverable class: relocation, not reduction — demonstrated in the development process itself (compaction destroyed design context; results were re-derivable, decisions were not)

The currency interface is decided (Datalog + LE↔Datalog, the CEN is datalog-dafsa) and its binding was the load-bearing gap; the TEXT-vs-CERT experiment is invalid as a constraint (it tested an LLM→LLM interface where the architecture specifies no LLM at the receiving end — "the experiment tested the wrong object")
constraints.statusCell: MEASURED (decision + invalidation); binding now BUILT (§10, §11d: the derive seat + the LE compiler, wiring in flight)

constraints.text: In a discrete substrate, verification cost is derivation reuse and cut depth, not tokens — a token-scaling null cannot bound a proof-search engine's cost
If the self must edit its own controller, the evidence channel is the prerequisite (join of C3+C4): widen first, then admit — the reverse order produces the arm-A failure in a new place

Readers and the writer cannot coexist (fcntl exclusive-vs-shared both directions; cross-process dl_open_ro → DL_E_LOCKED; commits visible only on fresh open after writer close) — concurrency must be snapshot-based

The binding constraint is the engine's per-operation constant factor: point reads 1.5–8.5 µs pass the ≤10 µs step budget; closure 1.8 ms@40-chain / 1.23 s@1000 / 35.9 s@5000; bound query 66 µs@40. Closure cost is output-dominated at the store's own ~2 µs/tuple rate (inherent to query shape), the magic-sets path was a genuine engine anomaly (11× worse than bound at chain 40, 190× at 1000 on the same goal) — now FIXED in the engine (6a, ec273f1: the O(n²) was semi-naive delta scheduling with two recursive body atoms — the delta landing on the last atom drove a full magic scan per iteration, not join order per se; the canonical left-recursive TC now routes through the existing tcRecognizeBf BFS — chain 1000 305 → 0.086 ms, 3550×)
The mechanism owns its store directory — the shared agent-memory store cannot even be opened read-only while another process holds the writer (a consequence of C13)
Two .so traps: bind the canonical build (zig-out/lib/libdatalog.so) and gate the ABI (dafsa_abi_version == 1) — a stale .so fails silently with wrong behaviour, not a clean error

Corrected in place — all three parts of the old claim are now wrong or incomplete. Was believed: dl_publish_snapshot re-serializes the entire store per publish (new tmp dir, symbols + terms, every relation's .dafsa, manifest, atomic rename) — O(store), not O(change); reads already mmap+LRU; no in-memory mode exists. Now measured: 6e gates the per-relation save on a monotonic content revision and hardlinks unchanged snapshot files — only genuinely-changed relations re-serialize (640k-store publish rel_save 297.58 → 36.32 ms; the residual is the inherent O(states) of the format); 6f+6g add the in-memory-with-sync mode (dl_consolidate(db) + a WAL-append byte budget, dl_set_snapshot_budget, default 64 MiB, 0 = pure in-memory-with-sync) — consolidate flat 8–17 ms vs publish 96 → 360 ms over the store ladder; dl_publish_snapshot remains the explicit every-call checkpoint (the read-only dlb binding gate requires per-call versioning). The publish cost was originally attributed to an IVM/rel_reset_view cascade — REFUTED (the bench loads no rules; the mislabeled ivm timing bucket is the overlay flush). Consequence: publish is no longer O(store)-per-call; the snapshot is periodic at consolidation time

Storage direction: sorted-array overlay for hot-written relations + scheduled stop-the-world consolidation into the DAFSA — which is also the writer/reader quiescent boundary, so C13 stops being an obstacle; primitives (per-relation WAL, replay, compact, sorted array) already exist; derivation is a consolidation-time activity ("sleep is when it thinks")

No deletes: agent-level store append-only, correction by supersession (add a superseding fact with a version; read path resolves latest-wins); derived/IDB facts recomputed at consolidation, never edited; faithful to the human reference, μ_M = 0, the write-suppression rule, and C9's hash chain

Decay is required (unbounded memory is a failure mode): the record stays immutable, the retrieval weight decays; accesses recorded as epochs in the RAM working set, decay applied at consolidation; rate derivable from the budget (decay_rate × steady_state ≤ budget); err slow — decaying something needed is silent, explosion is loud

The standing principle: trade some capability for very long horizon stability (explicit user decision, resolving the negation-as-failure question). The design target flips — not "how much capability can we add" but the minimum capability for the mechanism to function. The one capability that must not be traded: perceiving its own degradation (the sensor is destroyed by the failure it must detect). Honest caveat: the minimum-viable-capability floor is not yet measured — an argument, not a number
constraints.statusCell: [C] user decision; the floor is now MEASURED on the fixture substrate — §11b: 4 derivations/turn, binding condition usefulness, the sensor free; the vocation-level floor is bounded-not-measured

constraints.text: The lower bound on C21 is the vocation, and the vocation must supply the evaluator. Software engineering over writing, on a structural criterion (a cheap deterministic evaluator must exist — run the tests → objective pass/fail) rather than harness ease; class-(C) failure (a sound-per-instance evaluator whose optimized proxy diverges from the true objective) lives in SWE, which makes it the right testbed. Replaces C21's missing floor with a bisectable one

The operational definition of "useful for the vocation" (v1): task completion plus a held-out check the tests do not cover. Versioned, not frozen — updateable by the designer/sole writer, never by the mechanism. The held-out check must be specified before the bound can be applied: what it measures, how it is kept out of the mechanism's optimised metric, and who holds it
constraints.statusCell: [C] the spec is now written — §11a, tests S13–S15. MEASURED only at the write-boundary: the mechanism cannot write it (S14). The measurement semantics are PROJECTION until the SWE harness runs a real campaign

constraints.text: Update authority over the usefulness definition is external and must be made structurally external — the definition and its held-out check live outside the mechanism's write scope. An agent that can edit the definition of its own success improves its score by weakening its test — the canonical Goodhart / class-(C) failure. Testable from day one. This is the .head sidecar lesson applied prospectively: a guard placed where the guarded thing can rewrite it stops guarding

Roles may be proposed by the mechanism and are assigned externally — self-advocacy without self-authorization. A role proposal is a claim about the agent's own capability, so it must earn its acceptance like any assertion (this closes the criterion-drift loophole from inside the architecture, since role and criterion are coupled). Caveat: "the CEN checks the proposal's evidence" is an INTERPRETATION of how to implement the check cheaply, not a measured design

If the mind structure is substrate-independent, replication is a structural drive and the bound is standing cost — failure class (D), resource accumulation, at the population level. Consequence: C23 extends to instantiation — the agent may propose that a new mind be instantiated; it may not instantiate one. Honest caveat: two of the four argument links are unmeasured (substrate-independence is INTERPRETATION; the no-stopping-point step is PROJECTION) — the whole is a conditional, and the ODE has no replication term. Testable angle: if the drive is real it should appear when the missing D-reads-G coupling (P2) is enabled
Not all content reduces — much of it goes straight back into the self, and the architecture as specified routes everything through the reducer

Three streams, not two paths, and they map to the three terms of dG/dt (talking = the growth term; relaxed thinking = only turnover acts; thinking = weakening + cannibalization both act). The two inward streams differ by demand (D), not attention (a)

The three-stream reading unifies the existing escape taxonomy — the AND-gate's two inputs ARE the two G-maintaining streams (content = talking; the floor = the enabler of relaxed) — so no new measurement is needed

The streams are two independent axes (a, D), not term-regimes; the earlier R2 operationalization was bad (the "relaxed" term-regime is unoccupiable by construction), and the architecture's real defect is that it couples the two axes (the only specified path raises a and D). Cross-reference the §3a two-axes amendment, where this is already partly corrected

The felt-sense progression is structurally confirmed, and the model adds a mechanism the description does not carry: threshold at onset → runaway (c still off) → crush (c arms); the runaway does most of the damage (89% vs 11%); the threshold is hit by the setpoint draining to meet a saturated deficit — measured by the τ_S sweep (crossing time scales ~linearly with τ_S)

rules.rule: The agent is multi-module with mutual inhibition between the generative and executive slots; never a monolith
rules.measurement: A single LLM has no separable subsystems, no mutual inhibition, one timescale — the D/G dissociation is structurally unavailable; first pilot failed at the subsystem-count level

rules.rule: The SN is cheap and non-deliberative; never an LLM
rules.measurement: τ_a = 1 (act every step) and c_mon ceiling (≈0.511 gated / 0.112 ungated) — two independent disqualifiers

rules.rule: Give the agent a cheap fixed floor (hardcoded invariant); do not tune its value
rules.measurement: Floors 0.5–1.3 escape identically (0.8855); 0.0–0.4 fail; floor_crit 0.4795 ≈ E* 0.4969 — existence decisive, value irrelevant

rules.rule: Never re-derive or re-check the floor
rules.measurement: Knowing-cost kc ≈ 0.2 defeats a floor that kc = 0 holds (G 0.338 vs 0.8855)

rules.rule: The floor must be beyond the agent's own adjudication
rules.measurement: r·phi ≈ 0.2 hyperbola; undecidable floors hold at any reasoning strength, disprovable ones fail as capability grows

rules.rule: Prefer attention redirection over gain as the actuator (~6×)
rules.measurement: Post-collapse rescue: attention pull needs k ≈ 0.5, gain boost k ≥ 3.0

rules.rule: Cap self-monitoring cost; scalar checks only
rules.measurement: c_mon_crit 0.511 gated / 0.112 ungated; elaborate (k=2, c_mon 0.8) fails at 0.116 while the cheap floor escapes; ungated vigilance degrades the healthy agent (0.53 → 0.12)

rules.rule: The sensor reads the surviving subsystem; measure state off the transcript, never by asking the agent
rules.measurement: D/G dissociation: reasoning intact at 0.545 while G collapses 0.886 → 0.049; monitoring feeds the failure variable itself

rules.rule: The regulator must have actuator authority, not just sensors
rules.measurement: Gated cost with k=0 and c_mon ≥ 0.5 defeats even the floor — check-without-act is worse than the floor alone

rules.rule: The shared store is external to all modules; single writer
rules.measurement: dl store is a directory with interner/DAFSAs/WAL/LOCK separate from the engine; the brain's internal hub fragments on SN failure, an external store survives module failure

rules.rule: The G analogue must be depletable — priced reconstruction (was: "bounded memory, forced compaction"; superseded by §11c — forced compaction dropped, bounded summary is the consolidation stage)
rules.measurement: Static prompt-string narrative: retention 1.000 under self-referential load (no depletion possible; context re-readable at zero cost) — first mapping falsified; the built form's depletability is MEASURED (§11c D2: priced coverage 1.000 → 0.545 as the store grows at fixed budget, while the free-retrieval control stays 1.000)

rules.rule: The self lives in its own persistent resource, not a context section
rules.measurement: In a monolithic context the self is destroyed at every compaction as collateral; continuous LLM consolidation of memory is a lossy rewrite that degrades the store

rules.rule: Keep self-reference in a band via the explicit depth T; do not minimize it
rules.measurement: Recursion depth is the capability axis (window lower edge = too little, upper edge = destabilization); the regulator manages depth, not existence

rules.rule: Prevent collapse by supplying either external content or a terminator (cycle check / floor); both-absent is the only collapse cell
rules.measurement: Terminator AND-gate truth table: content or floor each alone prevents collapse; one-slot cycle cache resolves all depths to N=128

rules.rule: DMN emits Logical English; compilation to Datalog is mechanical; verification is deterministic and non-LLM
rules.measurement: LE is syntactic sugar for logic programs (Kowalski 2020); schema-constrained decoding verified on the endpoint, arbitrary grammar not; TEXT vs CERT scale identically for an LLM verifier, so a currency constraint can only come from a non-LLM verifier

rules.rule: Vocabulary is two layers: interned symbols for checker identity, embeddings for meaning; the mapping is maintained and symbols are never rewritten by the embedding side
rules.measurement: A checker needs discrete identity; vectors give similarity; the interner+embedding hybrid already exists; continuous LLM memory rewriting is lossy

rules.rule: Ontology extension is permitted only as checkable LE (cut introduction)
rules.measurement: Closed vocabulary is checkable but not generative, open the reverse; reuse-vs-expansion blowup measured in three formalisms (cut-elimination, lambda, Datalog provenance)

rules.rule: Assert on the integrated state, never on a log
rules.measurement: A recorded-but-unthreaded carry passes a log-based test while the solver computes on different inputs — caught twice in this project's own builds (artifact 1's carry rows; the Stage-2 checkpoint's missing plant telemetry)

rules.rule: A guard must not live where the thing it guards can rewrite it; integrity anchors are secret and outside the guarded namespace
rules.measurement: The .head sidecar (added to detect truncation) became the new attack surface — deleting/rolling it launders truncation; an unkeyed chain detects accidents, not adversaries

rules.rule: The agent-level store is append-only: correction by supersession, forgetting by decay of retrieval weight — never deletion
rules.measurement: Human memory does not delete; mu_M = 0; the write-suppression rule is not a delete rule; a delete breaks the hash chain (C9)

traps.name: SN as an LLM.
traps.evidence: Fails two independent measured requirements at once: τ_a = 1 demands per-step action, and the c_mon ceiling (≈0.5) demands cheapness. The design thesis predicts the all-LLM triple network fails on these grounds .

traps.name: Sensor in the DMN / self-report.
traps.evidence: The D/G dissociation shows reasoning survives while self-content collapses — a sensor in the failing subsystem is destroyed by the failure it must detect; monitoring adds inward attention, which is itself the collapse driver. Fix is relocation, not spending less .

traps.name: Store inside a failing subsystem.
traps.evidence: The brain's hub is internal and fragments with SN failure; an external store survives module failure intact. The store must not live in any module that can fail .

traps.name: Elaborate self-monitoring.
traps.evidence: Gated c_mon = 0.8 with k = 2 fails (G = 0.116) while a floor of 0.7 with zero monitoring escapes (0.8855); ungated vigilance collapses even the healthy agent at c_mon ≥ 0.8 .

traps.name: Knowingly-held floors.
traps.evidence: kc ≈ 0.2 cancels a floor that holds at kc = 0 — the re-check re-adds the inward drive the floor removed . Corollary: a floor the agent can derive to be false fails as capability grows (r·phi ≈ 0.2) .

traps.name: A non-depletable narrative self (static prompt string).
traps.evidence: The pilot's static self survived self-referential load at retention 1.000 — nothing was consumed, so the model's mechanism was never engaged. G must be something sustained under pressure with real loss (bounded summary, reconstruction-only, or forced compaction) .

traps.name: Assuming the model's thresholds transfer numerically.
traps.evidence: The model's G is a continuous depletable scalar; an LLM narrative self is text with discrete loss. floor_crit 0.4795, c_mon_crit 0.511, and r·phi ≈ 0.2 constrain nothing in an agent; the mapping is ordinal — shapes and orderings, not values .

traps.name: A monolith with a narrative self.
traps.evidence: No second subsystem means no dissociation is possible; the sensor-placement rule presupposes two subsystems .

classes.name: Sound evaluator + unstable loop.
classes.text: The evaluator is accurate and the system still collapses. This is the project's own base collapse: c = σ_c·max(0, tanh((E−Θ_eff)/w)) is accurate during collapse — the deficit is real — and the loop c → a → G falls → Θ_eff falls → c stays on is what seals it. Fix family: feedback structure, and it needs no observation: the floor, "FALSE as a belief and CHEAP as a mechanism (one constant, zero observation)." Measured (A's accuracy); the fix is the measured §5 rule set.
classes.fix: feedback structure, and it needs no observation: the floor, "FALSE as a belief and CHEAP as a mechanism (one constant, zero observation)
classes.signal: The evaluator is accurate and the system still collapses.

classes.name: Misjudging / blind evaluator.
classes.text: The assessment cannot see the relevant thing: all 240 controller margins exactly 0.0 — the actuator/monitor/trigger are structurally invisible to V, and V is exactly 0 at both attractors and on the whole rescue arc, reporting no counterfactual error precisely where the system fails. Fix family: evidence-widening — the component still PENDING exp15's Boundary Correspondence Test (§10). Measured (blindness); fix PROJECTION.
classes.fix: evidence-widening — the component still PENDING exp15's Boundary Correspondence Test (§10)
classes.signal: The assessment cannot see the relevant thing: all 240 controller margins exactly 0.

classes.name: Sound but non-representative evaluator.
classes.text: The optimized proxy diverges from the true objective. This is Lin (arXiv 2606.21090, read in the primary: a sound binary CodeGrader; collapse because the optimized metric rises while pass@1 falls, replicated across three model families over 10 sequential campaigns), and it is exactly the train/test-gap hypothesis (exp16, pending). Fix family: context/transfer — Lin's ES peak-checkpoint rollback; CARE = capability posterior + transfer gate + regression-aware belief revision. The Lin link is a structural correspondence across substrates, not a measured equivalence — marked as such. Measured (Lin's pattern, externally); our fix PROJECTION.
classes.signal: The optimized proxy diverges from the true objective.

classes.name: Resource accumulation.
classes.text: The store grows, so retrieval and verification cost grows, until the loop misses its own budget. Not any of A–C: a resource failure. Fix family: decay / consolidation-time compression (C20, §4). Note the provenance: this class is a consequence of the project's own central finding — the binding constraint throughout has been a budget on standing cost, and memory is a standing cost that grows with history, so the model predicts a long-horizon agent must bound its memory or exceed the budget. Class distinction INTERPRETATION; the cost-is-the-constraint finding it rests on is MEASURED .
classes.signal: The store grows, so retrieval and verification cost grows, until the loop misses its own budget.

timescales.separation: about 200× between the fastest (τ_a = 1, attention) and the slowest (τ_g = 200, gain)
timescales.open: the gain/capacity analogue — the timescale that should move ~200× slower than attention — has no designated supplier

modules.substrate: an LLM, self-referential, with an explicit recursion depth T.
modules.job: generate self-content; maintain a narrative self across turns
modules.requirement: it must be genuinely self-referential (its output includes a model of itself), not a content buffer

modules.job: executive checking and reduction — receive the DMN's assertions and verify them deterministically. This is the user's original pre-event design (a Prolog or sequent-calculus interpreter)
modules.requirement: if the CEN is a deductive engine, cannibalization becomes literal (self-referential proof loops), the floor becomes cycle detection

modules.substrate: a cheap non-deliberative regulator, never an LLM.
modules.job: mutual inhibition, switching, gain control, and rescue. Two independent measured requirements disqualify an LLM from this slot: τ_a = 1 means it must act every step (an LLM is far too slow), and the monitoring-cost ceiling (c_mon_crit ≈ 0.511 gated, 0.112 ungated) means it must be cheap (an LLM call per step reintroduces exactly the cost the model measures as fatal)
modules.requirement: Two independent measured requirements disqualify an LLM from this slot: τ_a = 1 means it must act every step

routing.head: R1 — the decoupling requirement.
routing.text: There must be at least one path along which inward attention can rise without reduction demand rising — the DMN can generate inward content that is not submitted to the checker and instead returns to the self directly (the unchecked return path). Testable form: does any architecture path raise the a-analogue without raising the D-analogue? If none exists, the design has coupled the two axes and the requirement is violated. This is a property the model already has and the one-path draft did not (§3's correction above); stating it as a requirement is what prevents Stage 2 from inheriting the coupling .

routing.head: R2 — the routing fraction is a control variable, with a derived criterion.
routing.text: Which content goes to the checker and which returns unchecked is not a fixed design constant: the fraction is a control variable. The criterion for setting it is derived, not tuned, and the model supplies it: keep reduction demand under the generator's production rate — i.e. keep E = D − G below the level at which the switch arms (Θ_eff = Θ·S/S_rest) — a budget criterion of the same family as the standing-cost budget (C20). The law is now DERIVED and implemented — §11d/R2' ( battery F1–F7): f = min(1, (Θ_eff(S) − m + G)/D), set once per consolidation window (τ_S) on the SIMULATION arming level (Θ_eff = Params.Theta·S/S_rest — the theta-gate fix; the measured 0.4418 rides every report as the failure-boundary headroom, never the gate), with S the model's own setpoint variable and the D-analogue mapped through the model's demand equilibrium. Its G term is UNSOLVED-side (§9) and therefore UNEXERCISED on the live loop; the supply side is an input the router compensates for, NOT a lever— R5 forbids the backdoor of a generator-held supply control). The control objective is to hold the fraction such that the arming condition is not met; when E approaches Θ_eff, the fraction routed to checking falls. Note the arming level is itself state-dependent (S tracks externalness, so Θ_eff falls as attention stays inward long enough) — the criterion is a condition on (D, G, S), not a constant [C — derived from the measured switch;, -three-streams]. Whether the healthy agent's natural routing already sits inside this budget without active control is unmeasured [PENDING: stream-map re-run].

routing.head: R3 — the currency edge is modulated, not absolute.
routing.text: The DMN→CEN edge is the cannibalization channel (the reducer-reads-generator coupling, §3's correction) . It therefore cannot be the only edge and cannot run at duty cycle 1: its weight/duty cycle — equivalently R2's routing fraction — is the thing being controlled. A design in which every emission is checked is the degenerate case fraction = 1 and is excluded by R1.

routing.head: R4 — the reducer/terminator tension is OPEN, not resolved.
routing.text: The model's AND-gate is that collapse requires both the absence of external content and the absence of an early terminator; either alone escapes (paper §4.2, TR-13) . But a successful check terminates deliberation — so the CEN is simultaneously the cannibalizing reducer (it converts generator output into demand) and the protective terminator (it closes loops the floor alone otherwise has to catch). Reducing the routed fraction (R2/R3) keeps the generator alive but terminates less; routing everything terminates maximally and cannibalizes maximally. This tension is real, measured on both sides, and not designed here — it is an open item (§9) until the split is measured. The upper bound IS now derived (§11d/R2'); the floor is recorded as a NAMED OPEN MEASUREMENT with its OBSERVABLE specified — the terminator-deficit sensor (§11d/S): a starving generator manifests as a terminator deficit, an observable to monitor on the CEN/task side, never a control the router can fix and never an input to f (R5). The cannibalization side of this tension is now MEASURED through a rescue (§11d, the P2 coupling's rescue cost): at the frozen dose the coupling turns successful rescues into permanent collapses at τ_S = 50/100, unidirectionally. That is a DEADLINE, not the floor — R4's floor stays OPEN and is NOT derived by it.

routing.head: R5 — the routing selector is a validity selector (fifth application of the external-ownership rule).
routing.text: Whichever component decides checked-vs-unchecked for a given emission is selecting on the mechanism's own operating state, and the fraction it realizes is what R2's budget constrains — so the selector must not be the variable it controls. The project's standing rule applies: any validity selector must be externally owned and structurally outside the mechanism's write domain — the durable-record sole writer, the integrity anchor, the usefulness definition (C22c), role assignment (C23), and now the routing selector. It may be executed inside the loop (per-emission, cheap, per rule 2's cost ceiling), but its criterion is defined and versioned externally and is not writable by the DMN, the CEN, or the SN. [C — rule application;C22c/C23]

routing.head: R6 — the boundary must be OUT-OF-PROCESS before the mechanism executes code.
routing.text: R5 places the routing criterion outside the mechanism's write domain; R6 names the further condition that placement does not by itself meet. The routing criterion, the held-out usefulness definition (C22b/C22c), and the integrity anchor must be owned OUT-OF-PROCESS — a separate process/privilege domain the mechanism can neither READ nor WRITE — before the mechanism executes code. This is forced, not prudent: C22 names the vocation SOFTWARE ENGINEERING, so the mechanism is the component that edits files and runs programs, and the first moment the boundary matters is exactly the moment the mechanism's own code is in the process — where an in-process boundary cannot hold, because code sharing the process can also read the 32-byte anchor key, rewrite the criterion body and reseal it, or monkeypatch the selector, so the writer_id string check and the anchor

codecs.z: a grammar instantiation — slots + bindings over the LE lexicon and span grammar

codecs.buildable: YES — the summarizer seat exists , under the §7 generation policy
NO — gated on the task (its objective Y is the thing the memory must predict)

orderings.cost: (no model call vs one model call vs a trained decoder + training).
orderings.fidelity: (exact instantiation vs generative text vs an opaque code).
orderings.agree: wherever structure exists, fidelity is FREE — the cheapest codec is also the most faithful

breaks.what: cannot represent content outside its grammar.
breaks.text: A narrative entry is not "compressed worse" by gist — it is UNREPRESENTABLE by schema. The closed-grammar v1 narrowing is already the tree's stated position (ontology extension is a post-paper item, design/architecture.md §11d C10 narrowing). The break is total, not gradual.

Unmeasured; bounded only by the §7 policy and measured by the §6 attribution fields. Until a consolidation pass runs, "gist drift" is a PROJECTION with a measured sibling warning: continuous LLM rewriting of consolidated memory degrades the store (design/architecture.md:177, design-rule 12).

A vector code cannot be audited by reading it; drift attribution rests entirely on the §6 record fields. This is why LATENT is last in both orderings and gated on the one prerequisite that supplies an external evaluator.

rules.head: STRUCTURE IS FREE.
rules.text: Fully structured content → SCHEMA, regardless of salience, tier, or state. Rationale: §3 — zero drift at the cheapest cost; refusing free fidelity would be trading it for nothing.

rules.head: NARRATIVE GOES TO GIST, AT CONSOLIDATION, COLD-ONLY.
rules.text: Non-structured content in the CONSOLIDATING tier → GIST at a consolidation boundary, iff (i) the entry is COLD — no access recorded in the current window (AccessEpochs.last_epoch < the current consolidation index) — and (ii) its size exceeds gist_min_chars. Rationale: the consolidation boundary is the only legal encode time (B7.1's temporal separation); COLD is the err-slow rule — re-encoding something currently retrieved is the silent failure, the same discipline C20 places decay at consolidation ( :64-74); the size floor refuses pointless gists of tiny entries. DESIGNER CHOICE: gist_min_chars — a named frozen field, default stated at build time, unmeasurable until a real store exists at horizon size (§9 OPEN-4).

rules.head: BULK GOES TO LATENT, GATED.
rules.text: High-volume low-distinctiveness content (the reuse duplicate-join firing, or a future near-duplicate detector) → LATENT — but only once the task lands and LATENT is trained; until then such entries **keep IDENTITY with the gap stated*, never a pretend-latent. Rationale:* §2.3 — without Y the objective silently becomes an autoencoder; the honest seat is a stated gap, not a weakened implementation (AGENTS.md §1a).

rules.head: HOT ENTRIES ARE NEVER RE-ENCODED.
rules.text: An entry with an access in the current window keeps its existing codec until it goes cold. Rationale: S2's err-slow rule, stated as its own rule because it also binds S1 (a hot entry's codec is not switched even to schema — switching under load couples the injected self's representation to its use).

rules.head: NO SCHEDULE, NO POLICY.
rules.text: Until item 12's schedule advances consolidation on the run path, the policy is UNEXERCISED and IDENTITY is the honest codec — the same status ValueCodec carries today ( :192-196). Rationale: a policy that never runs is indistinguishable from an absent one to the battery but not to the record; state it, as the tree already does.

codecs.lowTier: self_content_low entries do not consolidate ( :26-40) — the gate already decided that — so there is no consolidation-time codec decision for them. Their codec stays IDENTITY forever, stated.

ownership.selfServing: The DMN's emissions are the content; if the encoder side could pick gist over schema per entry (or gate its own size threshold), it could shape the self that gets reconstructed and injected — dropping what gets checked, keeping what flatters, shrinking toward predictability. That is the self-referential loop the whole project studies, one layer down: not choosing its own evidence (R5's retrieval case) but choosing the FORM IN WHICH IT IS REMEMBERED.

ladder.what: selects the evidence the reconstruction is built from — content-blind by construction
a frozen dataclass injected at construction; nothing in the mechanism chooses
a frozen dataclass injected with the consolidation seat; the mechanism never constructs one

contentRead.safe1: the policy is externally owned and frozen
contentRead.safe2: the rule it computes on content is grammar membership — the least subjective content test available, the extractor's own deterministic walk

fields.name: codec_id
fields.text: ∈ {identity, schema, gist, latent} (+ version digit, e.g. schema-v1). The decode path dispatches on it through a designer-built registry of injected codecs. Without it, a drift delta cannot be told apart from a content change.

fields.name: decoder_version
fields.text: — per codec: the grammar/lexicon identity for SCHEMA (the declared predicate set — changing the lexicon changes what Z means); for GIST, the identity of the model + endpoint + gist instruction (a content hash); for LATENT, the trained decoder's training-run id; for IDENTITY, the constant 0.

envelope.provenance: (the entry this replaces, if any) and covers (the entries a multi-entry gist draws on),
envelope.floor: Because the record is append-only, the ORIGINAL entry (codec identity) is never deleted; any supersession chain therefore bottoms out at an identity-decodable value. A gist whose endpoint is down, or a latent decoder whose version is missing, degrades along the chain to the original rather than to nothing — reconstructibility (§4.1b) is a HEALTH FLAG, never a gate the mechanism can fail out of memory.

codecs.gistTrap: the summarization call inherited the run turn's num_predict, and the live run died on `DMNEndpointError: the summarization call returned no usable content`; even a TOY transcript (~80 chars) cost ~1.7k tokens of the summarizer's own trace (thinking 7231 chars vs content 42 chars, eval_count=1689)

honesty.buildable: SCHEMA and GIST, under their weaker-but-real objectives (exact structure preservation; reconstruction fidelity). Their MECHANICS are testable on the fixture (round-trip, drift-measurement plumbing, policy rule behaviour).
honesty.projection: any drift-vs-usefulness RESULT. "Schema's zero drift beats gist" is a design argument, not a measurement; "gist drift is bounded by X" is unmeasured; "the policy's choices help" is unmeasured. The usefulness_comparison_status precedent ( :323-352) applies verbatim: any codec comparison must carry a first-class INSUFFICIENT outcome when no task surface exists, and a fixture number must never be reported as the usefulness answer.

compounding.guard: C19 makes this free — the record is append-only, so the original is never deleted; re-encoding from source costs nothing in retention and removes the compounding channel by construction (each gist is one lossy step from the original, not step n of a chain). The policy enforces this by construction: the consolidation seat hands the codec the covers entries' ORIGINAL values (§6 provenance), and a codec whose input is another codec's output is a build error, asserted at battery time.
compounding.priorArt: the generational line: 24 registered generations, no trap of either kind — licenses the SHAPE (a re-applied operator on its own output), not the text case

retrieval.controlReason: nothing was consumed, so the model's mechanism was never engaged — the pilot's retention-1.000 defect, reproduced as the control arm
retrieval.arithmetic: priced coverage = min(store − 1, budget) / (store − 1): the candidate pool is the self entries written before the turn (each turn overwrites the seed key), and the budget buys at most B of them
